version.changelog: After you update, run twelvetake-reaper-mcp --install-bridge. If REAPER is running the 1.7.8 bridge or later, you don't have to do anything in REAPER. If you installed with ReaPack, synchronize your packages instead. Fixed: - render_project didn't give plugins time to load, so a render could come out silent. REAPER's "Delay render start" option waits before a render so sample libraries and slow plugins can finish loading. The tool kept that setting but rendered without it, because REAPER asks how long to wait and that prompt would stop the bridge. The tool now does the wait itself, without the prompt. REAPER keeps working while it waits. By default the tool waits as long as your project's setting says, or not at all when the option is off. Pass delay_seconds to choose the wait for one render, or 0 for none. *(Found while looking into issue #21 from @Xleone1.)* Added: - render_project reports the rendered file's peak level and when its sound starts. The response gives peak_dbfs, silent: true when the file has no signal at all, and sound_starts_s, how far into the file the sound first rises above sound_threshold_db (-60 dBFS unless you set it). When a render is silent, or never gets above that level, the response says what to try. Your AI assistant can spot a silent render, or one whose sound starts late, without opening the file.
